title: Carote Ltd 异常信号雷达
body: 信号只陈述数值现象，不是风险结论。模型应结合引用原文分别说明可能业务解释与需警惕情形，区分事实与推论。经验阈值没有行业校准。

evidence.quote:
For the six months ended June 30, 2025, our net cash used in operating activities was approximately RMB18.7 million (same
period in 2024: our net cash generated from operating activities was approximately RMB89.9 million). This was primarily
driven by a substantial decrease in the net cash generated from core business operations of the group, which decreased
from RMB130.8 million for the Corresponding Period of the Previous Year to RMB16.8 million for the Reporting Period.
As the Group’s overseas and offline business segments grew, there was a corresponding need to procure more inventory
to support sales, leading to increased cash payments to suppliers. Secondly, the expansion of the offline business
has resulted in longer accounts receivable collection cycles, tying up cash. These factors increased working capital
requirements and consequently reduced the cash inflow from operations. Furthermore, a significant income tax payment
of approximately RMB41.2 million during the Reporting Period further offset the cash generated, contributing to the
overall net cash outflow from operating activities.

Average inventory turnover days of the Group increased from 38.8 days in 2024
to 53.1 days in 2025, mainly because we stocked more finished goods in overseas markets to meet the demand of our
rapidly growing branded business, as international shipping is generally lengthier in duration.

Average turnover days of trade receivables increased from 14.1 days in 2024 to
20.3 days in 2025, mainly driven by the sales growth in offline channels, which usually have longer trade receivables days
than sales through online channels.

Trade and bills payables of the Group decreased by approximately 13.9% from RMB397.0 million as of December 31,
2024 to RMB341.8 million as of June 30, 2025, mainly attributable to the overall decline in procurement by the Group.
Average turnover days of trade and bills payables remained relatively stable at 119.7 days in 2025 (2024: 111.4 days).

For the six months ended June 30, 2025, our net cash used in operating activities was approximately RMB18.7 million (same
period in 2024: our net cash generated from operating activities was approximately RMB89.9 million). This was primarily
driven by a substantial decrease in the net cash generated from core business operations of the group, which decreased
from RMB130.8 million for the Corresponding Period of the Previous Year to RMB16.8 million for the Reporting Period.
As the Group’s overseas and offline business segments grew, there was a corresponding need to procure more inventory
to support sales, leading to increased cash payments to suppliers. Secondly, the expansion of the offline business
has resulted in longer accounts receivable collection cycles, tying up cash. These factors increased working capital
requirements and consequently reduced the cash inflow from operations. Furthermore, a significant income tax payment
of approximately RMB41.2 million during the Reporting Period further offset the cash generated, contributing to the
overall net cash outflow from operating activities.

Average inventory turnover days of the Group increased from 38.8 days in 2024
to 53.1 days in 2025, mainly because we stocked more finished goods in overseas markets to meet the demand of our
rapidly growing branded business, as international shipping is generally lengthier in duration.

Average turnover days of trade receivables increased from 14.1 days in 2024 to
20.3 days in 2025, mainly driven by the sales growth in offline channels, which usually have longer trade receivables days
than sales through online channels.

Trade and bills payables of the Group decreased by approximately 13.9% from RMB397.0 million as of December 31,
2024 to RMB341.8 million as of June 30, 2025, mainly attributable to the overall decline in procurement by the Group.
Average turnover days of trade and bills payables remained relatively stable at 119.7 days in 2025 (2024: 111.4 days).

period in 2024: our net cash generated from operating activities was approximately RMB89.9 million). This was primarily
driven by a substantial decrease in the net cash generated from core business operations of the group, which decreased
from RMB130.8 million for the Corresponding Period of the Previous Year to RMB16.8 million for the Reporting Period.
As the Group’s overseas and offline business segments grew, there was a corresponding need to procure more inventory
to support sales, leading to increased cash payments to suppliers. Secondly, the expansion of the offline business
has resulted in longer accounts receivable collection cycles, tying up cash. These factors increased working capital
requirements and consequently reduced the cash inflow from operations. Furthermore, a significant income tax payment
of approximately RMB41.2 million during the Reporting Period further offset the cash generated, contributing to the
overall net cash outflow from operating activities.

Average inventory turnover days of the Group increased from 38.8 days in 2024
to 53.1 days in 2025, mainly because we stocked more finished goods in overseas markets to meet the demand of our
rapidly growing branded business, as international shipping is generally lengthier in duration.

Average turnover days of trade receivables increased from 14.1 days in 2024 to
20.3 days in 2025, mainly driven by the sales growth in offline channels, which usually have longer trade receivables days
than sales through online channels.

Trade and bills payables of the Group decreased by approximately 13.9% from RMB397.0 million as of December 31,
2024 to RMB341.8 million as of June 30, 2025, mainly attributable to the overall decline in procurement by the Group.
Average turnover days of trade and bills payables remained relatively stable at 119.7 days in 2025 (2024: 111.4 days).
